evidence.label: mcp-go-shell-exec-interpreter (critical/medium)
evidence.detail: A shell interpreter is invoked with a constructed command string. Go's exec.Command is safe by default precisely because it takes an argument vector; routing through `sh -c` gives that safety away.

evidence.label: mcp-js-prototype-pollution-merge-loop (medium/medium)
evidence.detail: Keys from a caller-supplied object are copied onto a target without excluding __proto__ / constructor / prototype. A tool argument carrying __proto__ then mutates Object.prototype for the whole process, which can turn an unrelated later property read into attacker-controlled data.

evidence.label: authentication_model
evidence.detail: source reads a credential header but no enforcing middleware or rejection path was found — `03` §4's "present but optional or trivially bypassable" band

evidence.label: transport_security
evidence.detail: declared endpoint(s) are HTTPS: https://exchange.lamdis.ai/mcp; scored 80, not 100: `03` §4 reserves 100 for HTTPS *with HSTS*, and an HSTS header can only be seen by connecting, which `04` §9 does not do. This is an unverifiable band, not an observed absence.

evidence.label: secret_handling
evidence.detail: detect-secrets matched 23 credential-shaped string(s), every one from a keyword or entropy heuristic (Base64 High Entropy String, Basic Auth Credentials, Hex High Entropy String, Secret Keyword). Those flag placeholders, variable names and content hashes as readily as credentials, so they do not establish the committed credential `03` §4's 0 asserts, and this sub-check is not scored; Basic Auth Credentials at bench/sample50.json:1; Secret Keyword at node/cmd/lamdis/review.go:137; Secret Keyword at node/internal/account/account.go:159; Secret Keyword at node/internal/agent/connect_test.go:21; Secret Keyword at node/internal/agent/connect_test.go:33; Hex High Entropy String at node/internal/agent/connect_test.go:41; Secret Keyword at node/internal/agent/oauth.go:191; Secret Keyword at node/internal/agent/provision.go:130; Secret Keyword at node/internal/agent/provision_test.go:45; Basic Auth Credentials at node/internal/agent/runner_test.go:288; …and 13 more matches

evidence.label: authorization_granularity
evidence.detail: no tool registration was recognised anywhere in the source. An MCP server registers tools by definition, so this is a gap in our detection rather than a server with none, and `03` §4's threshold cannot be applied to it.
